column1: # Narration for the demo, one line per row, pipe separated:
#   <second on the assembled timeline>|<words>
# The assembled file is three pieces: the HyperFrames explainer (0-25s), the walkthrough of the
# deployed site (25-480s), and the HyperFrames end card (480-492s). This is the long cut: every step of
# the case, every wallet confirmation and every explorer page is on screen, and the narration talks
# through the flow rather than over it. Starts are placed against the screen map measured from the
# shipped file itself, at one frame every three seconds:
#     0.0 -  25.0  explainer: the idea, the mechanic, the tolerances, the proof
#    25.0 -  65.0  the landing page, scrolled whole
#    65.0 -  76.0  the overview: the bond, the held bonuses, what needs a decision
#    76.0 - 145.0  the case opens, and the wallet is funded
#   145.0 - 215.0  the lie size, and the false print signed for
#   215.0 - 285.0  the loan: approval, then the position
#   285.0 - 355.0  the real price and the false one, both read back
#   355.0 - 425.0  the liquidation, the hold, the second print
#   425.0 - 462.0  upheld, settled, and the explorer
#   462.0 - 471.0  the case list
#   471.0 - 479.0  prove a price, and closing
#   479.0 - 492.0  end card: what is live, and where to look
# Numbers are spelled as they are spoken, there is no marketing vocabulary, and every claim is one the
# viewer can check on screen in the same shot. Only rows that begin with a digit are read. The rate is
# left at the voice's own pace, and build_narration.sh refuses to build a track whose line outlasts the
# section it is talking about.
0.4|A feed's price decides what a loan is worth.
5.4|The bonus a liquidation pays is computed from that price.
10.9|Two sources have to agree within five per cent.
15.7|The bonus is held for five minutes. The debt is not.
20.6|Anyone can challenge. The contract decides.
25.5|This is the landing page: what is held back, and why.
33.5|The liquidator's profit is held for five minutes. The debt is not.
42.0|The landing page sets out what the contract checks, and what it holds.
52.0|Five rules, each one a predicate over state the contract already has.
60.0|Then the contracts, and the tests behind them.
65.5|The dashboard, reading the chain: the bond a feed carries, and what needs a decision.
78.0|A visitor can run the whole case. The page says what the wallet needs first: test gas.
88.0|Funding the wallet is the visitor's own transaction.
100.0|The feed's operator runs on the server, so a visitor never needs that key.
108.0|Every step here is a transaction the visitor signs.
114.0|The case opens with the feed's honest print, and the peer's print beside it.
121.5|Step one done. The page keeps the wallet's shortfall on screen until it is fixed.
131.0|The visitor chooses how far the feed will lie. Eight per cent is enough to be provable.
148.5|The false print is a transaction, so the wallet asks first.
159.5|The request names the contract it calls, and the fee, before anything is signed.
178.5|Once printed, the page reads the print back from the chain.
190.5|Eight per cent off a second source is over the five per cent tolerance, so it is provable.
208.5|Next, the loan. The collateral is escrowed until the case ends.
221.5|That is two transactions: an approval, then the loan itself.
236.5|The position is live, and the collateral sits with the protocol.
243.5|The collateral and the debt are read from the position, not typed in.
250.5|Each transaction has its own receipt, and a step completes only when it lands.
266.5|The wallet reports it confirmed.
272.0|The feed has now printed the real price and the false one.
286.0|The contract holds both, with the round each one belongs to.
302.0|Printing is free. Pricing is not: a band needs four prints behind it.
314.0|The market liquidates on the false print, and the bonus is held instead of paid.
330.0|The hold runs five minutes, and the challenge window with it.
348.0|The feed prints again, and the run page tracks what the bond is carrying.
366.0|The run page keeps every step's transaction, and its result.
382.0|Upheld: the print contradicted the record, so the borrower is made whole.
398.0|Settling is one more transaction, signed the same way.
412.0|The case is closed. The collateral is back with the borrower.
428.0|Every transaction links to the explorer, where it can be read.
434.0|The transaction page: the call, the logs, and the block it landed in.
445.0|The prove page lists the bonuses held and every verdict reached.
462.0|The case list shows all seven cases, each with the bond it paid.
474.0|Prices you can check, and a record you can read.
480.0|Six contracts on Arbitrum Sepolia, with no owner.
487.0|Every number on it is read from the chain.
